connector.name: Universal Brute Workpack
connector.registryDescription: Stdio-first Agent MCP workpack for local tools, audit chains, search, memory, and pipelines.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package universal-brute-workpack. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the haoyun18881-beep account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
